_note: SAMPLE list. Member 5 owns this file and replaces it with the real accepted alternatives per state.
aadhaar: Voter ID, ration card or any other photo ID if available
Attestation by the Gram Panchayat Pradhan or ward councillor
Apply for a reprint at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra (we can draft the request)
ration_card: Name in the local PDS / ration dealer register
land_record: Khatian / RoR copy from the state land records portal
Certificate from the Block Land & Land Reforms Office (BL&LRO)
Geo-tagged photos of the plot plus neighbour attestation
bank_passbook: Account details from the bank branch or a bank statement
Aadhaar-seeded account (DBT) confirmation from the bank
house_ownership: Panchayat tax receipt or electricity bill
Geo-tagged, time-stamped photos of the damaged house (from this app)
Neighbour attestation countersigned by the panchayat
_default: Attestation by the Gram Panchayat or local revenue officer
Geo-tagged, time-stamped photos submitted through this app
